gitgraph.comment: Read gitGraph and an immediately joined colon when present. A separated colon or header direction remains available to the following header rules. Follows detection.md#the-detectors and gitgraph.md#detection.

patterns.comment: Read case-sensitive statement keywords only when a longer reference does not own their spelling. Follows gitgraph.md#keywords-and-components.
patterns.name: keyword.control.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read listed commit display values as fixed values. Follows gitgraph.md#ordered-rules.
patterns.name: constant.language.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read the listed header direction as a fixed value. Follows gitgraph.md#detection.
patterns.name: constant.language.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read each option key and its separate colon, preserving directives between those components. Follows gitgraph.md#keywords-and-components.
Read title lines and the colon-led or braced forms of accessibility metadata. Follows gitgraph.md#composite-common-forms.
Read an unsigned order number before the reference fallback. Follows gitgraph.md#numbers-and-references.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read the shared matching-quote strings and backslash escapes. Follows gitgraph.md#strings.
Read a native YAML region from a three-dash opening fence to the first qualifying unindented closing fence. Follows gitgraph.md#hidden-yaml.
Read a native ignored percent-brace region through its earliest brace-percent closer with a following whitespace or end-of-input boundary. Follows gitgraph.md#hidden-directive-and-line-endings.
Read a native percent-pair comment up to physical line end or a separator-led common comment. Follows gitgraph.md#whitespace-and-comments.
Read a bare branch reference as an element name. Follows gitgraph.md#numbers-and-references.
patterns.name: variable.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read the separate header colon. Follows gitgraph.md#detection.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.separator.colon.mermaid

gitgraph-line-final-keywords.comment: Read a reserved keyword at a statement start when only padding and directives follow on its physical line. A value on a later line receives the surrounding context's scopes. Follows gitgraph.md#composite-common-forms and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
